decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - REASONS FOR REFUSAL

1. The proposed alterations and extensions are considered to be detrimental to the character and appearance of the house itself and the Bedfont Green Conservation Area in which the application premises are located, by reason of the excessive bulk of the extensions. It would therefore be contrary to the adopted Unitary Development Plan policy ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation areas) and would not preserve or enhance the character of the conservation area.

2. It is considered that the proposed rear extension, by reason of its bulk and location, would be detrimental to the amenities of the next door neighbour to the north in that it would unreasonably affect outlook and reduce daylight and sunlight. For these reasons it would be contrary to Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV B.1.1 (New development) and H.6.45 (Extensions and alterations) as well as the Supplementary Planning Guidance in the form of the Residential Extension Guidelines 2002.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of two storey rear extension and single side garage extension to dwellinghouse. (Amended design of the proposal)
